method_inquiry.reason: These methods are essential for understanding how to correctly implement the icon addition in the HTML structure, as they define the context in which the icon will be used.

retrieved_methods.source:
def icon(self,
             icon: str,
             title: Optional[str] = None,
             middle: bool = True,
             id_: Optional[str] = None,
             cssclass: Optional[str] = None,
             class_: CSSSpec = None,
             emblem: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        self.write_html(
            self.render_icon(icon_name=icon,
                             title=title,
                             middle=middle,
                             id_=id_,
                             cssclass=cssclass,
                             class_=class_,
                             emblem=emblem))
